definitions.explanation: Something made to imitate or resemble the genuine article, typically with intent to deceive.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{偽|にせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧だ。
examples.english: This is a counterfeit brand-name product.

examples.japanese: ⟦{偽|にせ}{札|さつ}→偽札：16634_nisesatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{偽|にせ}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見分|みわ}ける→見分ける：06348_miwakeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: It's difficult to tell the real from the fake.

notes:
{偽|にせ} means "fake" or "counterfeit" and functions both as a standalone noun and as a prefix that attaches to other nouns to indicate something is not genuine.

COMPOUNDS:
- {偽|にせ}もの: fake item, counterfeit
- ⟦{偽|にせ}{札|さつ}→偽札：16634_nisesatsu⟧: counterfeit money/bills
- {偽|にせ}{名|な}: false name, alias
- {偽|にせ}⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧: fake doctor, quack
- {偽|にせ}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: false information

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧: counterfeit, imitation (the noun form)
- {贋作|がんさく}: forgery (specifically of art or antiques)
- ⟦フェイク→フェイク：11282_feiku⟧: fake (loanword, common in fashion and media)
- {模造品|もぞうひん}: imitation product (neutral; focuses on the copying)
⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧ (the real thing, genuine article) is the opposite of ⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧. The pattern ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{偽物|にせもの}→偽物：11521_nisemono⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ (real or fake?) is very common.
